notes.title: Japan Trip — New Update Available! 🇯🇵✨
notes.content:
Thank you for your continued support of Japan Trip!
We’ve just released a fresh update packed with new experiences, enhancements, and a few spicy surprises 😉

As always, your feedback is incredibly valuable to us — don’t hesitate to share your thoughts!

Stay tuned and enjoy the trip,
The Development Team

notes.title: Trading Cards Update: New Collectibles in Japan Trip!
notes.content:
Exciting news for all Japan Trip fans! We've just released a brand-new update that introduces collectible trading cards, shiny new badges, and exclusive profile backgrounds. Dive deeper into your adventure in Tokyo while collecting these awesome rewards to showcase on your Steam profile. Complete your collection, unlock unique avatars, and flaunt your new level of mastery in Japan Trip. Join the fun and enhance your gaming experience today!

Prepare your collection skills, and let the journey begin!

notes.title: Japan Trip: Major Update! New Endings, Video Gallery, and More! 🇯🇵✨
notes.content:
Pack your bags and get ready for an unforgettable adventure in Japan Trip with our latest update! 🛫🌸

🌟 Upgraded Video Gallery: Relive the hottest moments from your journey with ease—our video gallery is now smoother and more user-friendly, perfect for revisiting those steamy encounters! 🎥🔥
🌟 Visual Enhancements: We’ve polished the visuals for a more vibrant and immersive experience. Tokyo has never looked this good! 🌆✨
🌟 New Dialogue Choices and Endings: Your Tokyo story just got deeper with fresh dialogue options and multiple new endings—now your decisions matter even more! 💬🎯
🌟 Relaxing Soundtracks: Drift away with new ambient tunes to enhance your trip. 🎶🌸
🌟 Bug Fixes and More: Several improvements under the hood to keep your journey smooth and exciting! 🛠️

The time has never been better to join this thrilling Tokyo adventure! 🇯🇵 Charm the local girls and let your fantasies run wild in the city of dreams!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45270886/9e37a50b25c6de658ffb0941fcde8271c88789a4.png[/img]

notes.title: Japan Trip Release! Discover New Dialogues and Hot X-Scenes
notes.content:
Japan Trip is officially released, bringing you exciting new features! Explore Tokyo, win over the girls, and dive into romance with newly added dialogue options, steamy X-scenes, and fresh endings. Enhanced animations bring even more depth to the game, making each interaction even more immersive. Join the adventure and experience a love story like never before in the vibrant city of Tokyo!

notes.title: The Tokyo Adventure Begins in 2 Days – Get Ready for Flirtation and Passion!
notes.content:
Just 2 days left until the release of Japan Trip! Prepare yourself for an unforgettable journey through one of the world's most exciting cities—Tokyo. Immerse yourself in a world of dazzling lights, romance, and seduction, where you’ll have the chance to meet and win over beautiful Japanese girls. Your mission is not just to explore the city, but to capture their hearts through flirtation, charm, and choices that will shape the course of the story. Get ready for intrigue, unforgettable dates, and sizzling moments that will leave a lasting impression!
